{"inp":{"code":"# Calculations for VALE3 price target based on given metrics
VPA = 48.438876
LPA = 7.400813
EBIT = 7.129e10  # EBIT 12m
# Derive shares outstanding using Lucro Liquido and LPA
Lucro_liq = 3.1592e10
shares = Lucro_liq / LPA
EBIT_per_share = EBIT / shares
p_vp_target = VPA * 1.70
p_l_target = LPA * 8.0
p_ebit_target = EBIT_per_share * 4.0
weighted = 0.5 * p_vp_target + 0.3 * p_l_target + 0.2 * p_ebit_target
shares, EBIT_per_share, p_vp_target, p_l_target, p_ebit_target, weighted
print(f"shares={shares:.0f}")
print(f"EBIT_per_share={EBIT_per_share:.4f}")
print(f"P/VP target={p_vp_target:.2f}")
print(f"P/L target={p_l_target:.2f}")
print(f"P/EBIT target={p_ebit_target:.2f}")
print(f"Weighted target={weighted:.2f}")
print(weighted)"} }
